scope: new pre-registered engineering request in the complete model environment
purpose: Qualify the actual loaded closure inside a real complete-model delivery request, and place the publication gate where the 8 s + 2 s budget can still absorb it.

candidate_covers: the module map, native map and explicit-path list
candidate_does_not_cover: files in the registered tree that the request never loads
package trees that are not imported
a lazy import that happens after the last capture
semantic behaviour of a file whose bytes are unchanged
identity_semantics.old_gate: registered whole-tree source gate (scan every registered source/pyc/native file)
old_gate_covers: every file in the registered tree whether or not it is loaded
mutation of a file the request never loads
old_gate_does_not_cover: cost: a full tree scan measured 5.618649 s for 8903 files, which cannot fit inside an 8 s request together with inference and cold-chain evaluation
identity_semantics.resolution: the request uses the candidate at three capture points inside the budget and states explicitly that whole-tree coverage is NOT provided inside the request; a whole-tree check remains an out-of-request publication precondition, run before the timed request, never inside it
capture_points: P1 after model and explicit files are loaded
P2 after the first JAX call and the first native (C++) call
identity_semantics.fail_closed_rule: publication is refused if any capture differs from the previous capture in file hashes, file set, module map, native map or explicit-path list; on refusal the original plan is retained, the request is recorded as partial and nothing is published

out_of_request: process start up before the timed section

resource_gates.gpu_policy: record GPU utilisation; do not schedule any GPU-dependent stage while either GPU is heavily loaded

preconditions_before_server: resource snapshot recorded from the server (RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json)
no owned remote process from a previous round remains
non_goals: rerun of any old failed request to chase a PASS
any GPU-dependent stage while the GPUs are loaded
failure_criteria: any capture-point difference inside the request
publication without a stable P2 to P3 comparison
budget overrun of the 8 s execution or the 2 s recovery reserve
RAM below the 8 GiB backbone gate or an owned leftover process on the host
qualified_here: the three-point fail-closed protocol, tested locally with 7 checks
the identity-semantics mapping between the candidate and the whole-tree gate
not_qualified_here: the real model native lazy-import surface
the 3080 source identity against the registered shard set
